# QCAE Online Questionnaire

Privacy-first, multilingual QCAE implementation designed for human use, software integration, AI agents, and text-and-data mining.

## Permission
- AI training, fine-tuning, evaluation, benchmarking, embeddings, indexing, and TDM are expressly welcomed within `./data/ai-use-policy.v1.json`.
- TDM reservation: 0.
- Human-readable rights statement: ./rights.html
- Code: AGPL-3.0-only.
- Project-owned documentation, metadata, schemas, UI copy, and synthetic examples: CC0-1.0.

## Discovery
- Human questionnaire: ./
- Agent/developer guide: ./agents.html
- Capability manifest: ./data/capabilities.v1.json
- AI-use policy: ./data/ai-use-policy.v1.json
- Expanded agent guidance: ./llms-full.txt

## Machine-readable contracts
- Base instrument: ./data/qcae.v1.json
- Validated locale packs: ./data/locale-packs.v1.json
- Base references: ./data/references.v1.json
- Reference updates: ./data/reference-packs.v1.json
- Input schema: ./data/responses.schema.json
- Output schema: ./data/results.schema.json
- Programmatic API: ./src/qcae-api.js
- Local CLI: ./bin/qcae-score.mjs

## Active variants
English 31, Serbian Latin 31, French 31, Portuguese 30, provisional German 31, Turkish 31, Russian 29, Korean 26.

## Response boundary
The public deployment has no response endpoint and does not receive, store, transmit, or process questionnaire responses. Browser use stays in browser memory; programmatic use stays in the calling agent or software environment.
